# SCS Telemetry and Input SDK 1.16

<!-- Edited by: OpenAI-Codex_Responsible: Source_Code -->

This directory vendors the unmodified `include/` headers and `sdk_license.txt` from SCS Telemetry and Input SDK 1.16. The SDK is available from the [official SCS telemetry documentation](https://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Documentation/Engine/SDK/Telemetry) as [scs_sdk_1_16.zip](https://download.eurotrucksimulator2.com/scs_sdk_1_16.zip). The ZIP is 63,348 bytes and has SHA-256 `49821E25568F4D7E462135F577F8FEF2AB197326404F2C1DAEF139B8F3DC5E69`.

The included SDK content is MIT licensed, Copyright (C) 2016 SCS Software; see [sdk_license.txt](sdk_license.txt). The examples and SDK readme are not vendored.

`MANIFEST.sha256` records the SHA-256 of the 20 headers and the license file. Verify from this directory with `sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256`.

To update, manually download the official SDK, verify its ZIP hash against a trusted value, and replace the included files together. Do not edit the SDK headers by hand; regenerate and verify the manifest after an update.
